ActivityEventOut.description:
One audit event, identifiers only, through `audit_trail.api` (§4.7). The UI words it;
a withdrawn upload never carries its file name (ADR-162).
ActivityEventOut.title: ActivityEventOut

BinderClientPreviewOut.description: POR-03 as a recipient will see it, for BND-02's "Preview as client" sheet.
BinderClientPreviewOut.title: BinderClientPreviewOut

BinderIn.description: Create a Draft: blank, from a firm template, or from the prior-year binder.
BinderIn.title: BinderIn

BinderLiveOut.description: What BND-02 polls every 5 s while visible (DEC-23, DV-3).
BinderLiveOut.title: BinderLiveOut

BinderOut.description: The BND-02 record projection: rail, categories with counts, publish-bar facts.
BinderOut.title: BinderOut

BinderRequestRowOut.description: A BND-02 row. Client principals never receive a Draft or an internal-only row (INV-4).
BinderRequestRowOut.title: BinderRequestRowOut

BinderRowOut.description: A BND-01 row. Counted and listed after `visible()`: a walled binder is absent (INV-3).
BinderRowOut.title: BinderRowOut

FollowUpDraftsIn.description: BND-01 b (binders) or BND-02 d (requests of one binder): one of the two lists.
FollowUpDraftsIn.title: FollowUpDraftsIn

FollowUpOut.description:
One follow-up: who it goes to, the open requests it lists (each once), and the email
exactly as it will be sent. `body` is template-composed (DEC-79: never model text) or the
person's edit.
FollowUpOut.title: FollowUpOut

FollowUpOverrideIn.description: `null` clears the override; the firm's cadence applies again.
FollowUpOverrideIn.title: FollowUpOverrideIn

RequestItemPatchIn.description: Edit any non-terminal request (SHL-14 b). Absent fields are unchanged.
RequestItemPatchIn.title: RequestItemPatchIn

RequestItemV2Out.description: The SHL-14 record: the extended request (P-06 §4.2) with its `allowed_actions`.
RequestItemV2Out.title: RequestItemV2Out

ScreeningCardOut.description:
SHL-20 a-e: the request batch's screening ("29 of 31 files answer the request"). `verdict`
is C2's `evidence_screening` glyph; a verdict never carries a percentage (P-06 §7).
ScreeningCardOut.title: ScreeningCardOut

UploadIntentOut.description: Lives 90 s; R-01 posts it again while the upload runs (UNLOGGED, swept).
UploadIntentOut.title: UploadIntentOut

WithdrawalOut.description: Void and hidden at once; erased after `erase_after` unless a legal hold applies.
WithdrawalOut.title: WithdrawalOut
